input.interpretation: Outcome: the study ends unconfirmed and must not be reported as a solution. No candidate+task+controller combination has a passing development result, so selected_execution was never set, selection remains null, and 0 of 2 required fresh post-selection confirmations exist. Evidence produced in this study: (1) mathematics - both authorized solve attempts returned known_killed_waited_timeout at their 600 s allowances (ad10e4190cead8c06b5c0f623d33e06dd055340e78fbaa66dc79255e7d2d1eda at 20 substeps, charged 600.041 s; 58aa1fbc64101f384faeaaed193312781fb51737bf42fff840d2081b865364d2 at 5 substeps, charged 600.036 s), each with relaxed_nlp_feasible, original_task_feasible, trajectory_metrics and original_task_gaps all null, so no mathematical design verdict exists and mathematical feasibility was never established; mathematical trajectories would not have demonstrated original MuJoCo acceptance in any case. (2) NMPC - nmpc_admission reported available=false with complete_execution_s=null and no matching timing evidence, so search/execution was unavailable within budget; this is a budget-admission result, not an assessment that the design is infeasible, and 0 of 4 NMPC executions were used. (3) RL - residual mode was unavailable because no compatible reference is advertised (compatible_references=[]), so direct mode was used. Trial training-summary-formal-20261013-9fd0bb09 (declared 102400 actions / 600 active s) terminated twice on the same infrastructure PermissionError renaming state.json during policy optimization (training summaries a65fa8050d03e7e4957aba48661773a03255ba1c0e0d134d4f240d54857ec597 at 43520 actions / 87.427 active s and 1eb62bb0f7643b1d25fa325cf903f92f8da80765ce4578cece4cae8b8dd426d2 at 51968 actions / 104.685 active s); a same-configuration resume under the original remainder was refused with DEPENDENCIES_CHANGED_COMMIT_AND_MIGRATE_WITHOUT_RESETTING_COSTS, so that trial is closed short of its allocation. Its two published checkpoints were evaluated independently and both failed the frozen criteria: 4c099449cbc8617d1f72156b56b769bd3130219c9f8f44bae797600d12762b6a at actual num_timesteps 43264 (complete 35/35 actions, 700 physics steps, numerical_failure null, terminal error 0.169949 m, holding max error 0.170258 m, holding max speed 0.161806 m/s, reward -6119.148) and e6c5f7c64754536b24b82e2b03003956f57c57ba75215a7e53bff11605f1ddf9 at actual num_timesteps 51456 (complete, no numerical failure, terminal error 0.116702 m, holding max speed 0.083379 m/s, reward -3266.242); that is 17x and 12x the 0.01 m tolerance and 8x and 4x the 0.02 m/s limit, so both are retained as failures, not as partial passes. Trial training-summary-formal-20261013-fb54a8b8 (effective allocation 199936 actions = 256 x 781, active_seconds 1200) was still running at closeout: last read status running at checkpoint step-00136960-ef00383e (136960 actions, 252.072 active s, 3194 complete / 984 failed episodes, rollout/ep_rew_mean -166.7, value_loss ~90, explained_variance ~0.84) and last supplied packet state 142848 actions / 262.574 active s with checkpoint step-00142848-bc96e639 and episode_failure_fraction 984/4346 = 0.2264 (training summary 29e1ea8840aea07d6de36356bf5c4e6906227b87ce703a1f1fd7413afcd5dabb); its reward and failure-fraction trends improved substantially over trial 1, but no threshold-passing result was ever measured, so it is training evidence only and no checkpoint of it was evaluated. Note as an observation, not a root-cause diagnosis: neither development evaluation reproduced a numerical failure (both completed the 0.35 s horizon with numerical_failure null), unlike the sealed historical record that failed QVEL at action 23 / substep 2 near 0.2205 s; no mechanism is claimed. Budgets were not treated as targets: 2 of 2 mathematics attempts were used, 2 of 3 RL trials were opened (1 reserved, 2nd closed short by an infrastructure fault), the first trial's declared allocation was left incomplete after resumption became unavailable, 1 RL evaluation of the 3 non-reserved slots remains unspent, 0 of 4 NMPC executions were used, the optional 60 s diagnostic was not used, and the two reserved fresh confirmations were untouched because no passing result existed. Nominal single-episode evaluations support no robustness claim, no improvement attribution is made without comparable evidence, and no algorithm-superiority claim is made.

input.weakening_observation: Development evaluations remain far outside the frozen thresholds: terminal error 0.169949 m at actual step 43264 and 0.116702 m at actual step 51456 (17x and 12x the 0.01 m tolerance) with holding max speed 0.161806 and 0.083379 m/s (8x and 4x the 0.02 m/s limit); both are complete 35-of-35-action episodes with numerical_failure null, so they fail on task criteria rather than on physics. No training run reached a state that could be evaluated as passing, and the run whose metrics were still improving most was cut by infrastructure faults, so the claim that the frozen criteria can be met within this budget remains unsupported.
